digest.component_or_area: bridge state format and store compatibility
propositions: Three committed format changes to .bridge_state (A2: last_get_pass relocation, A3: scalar normalization, A4-2: prev_snapshot narrowing) and field deletion (A1: baseline_advanced_at) require architectural documentation with rollback boundaries and mixed-version protocol discovery.

Mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) reads and stops legacy writes only after direct deployment evidence (A2-1 merged, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process), not elapsed time.
Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral runners require durable state; off-branch relocation was rejected by epic 6c9c.
A2-1 reversible, A3 reversible through idempotent read-path canonicalization, A2-2 rollback only to A2-1-or-newer, A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Assignee excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
Marginal cost reduced from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB after A1; 218/399 prev key sets identical; measured in session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.
